results.step: 1 inside the mandate: Oceanic 0.25 runs on its own and is final on Arc
2 outside the mandate: Brightline 0.75 waits for the second key, then pays
3 breaks a rule: "Oceanic" at a new address is blocked, no Circle call
4 drift: Harbor 0.60 approved, amount changed by 0.50, approval void, nothing sent
5 idempotency: INV-88213 retried with the same key returns the same payment
6 audit: chain verifies and each paid payment has its Circle tx id and Arc tx hash
7 balance: treasury dropped by exactly the amounts paid plus their USDC gas
